summary: Accept fractal-prefixed work wakes and reserved message tags while keeping st3 writers unchanged.

replay.detail: Durable signed and stored messages are decoded in place, never rewritten.

schema.detail: Existing recipient and subject indexes remain in use; no schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: Work-wake readers and reserved-tag admission accept st3- and fractal-. Repeated tags retain all values, with matching st3- work values considered first; a manual wake-source under either prefix excludes the message from automatic attempts. Writers still emit st3-. Run-report idle projection compatibility is deferred because its persistent triggers and indexed projection require a separate change.

downtime.detail: Reader-only change; no service interruption required.

manual.detail: No message rewriting or operator steps.

recovery.detail: Existing writers remain compatible with the previous release; do not switch writers until all readers are expanded.
